# Message source to receiver

This project explores error-correcting codes from source to receiver. Lean 4
will define the mathematical objects and verify their properties, Python and
Plotly will provide interactive visualizations, and Quarto will bring the
explanations and demonstrations together.

## Project areas

- **Lean 4:** bit vectors, encoders, decoders, Hamming distances, and proofs.
- **Python and Plotly:** interactive visualizations of codewords, distances,
  and error-correction paths.
- **Quarto:** integrated documentation and presentations.

The Lean implementation will follow test-driven development: expected
properties and proof tests are written before their implementations.
